metrics.title: 老人总数
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM person_info WHERE deleted = 0

metrics.title: 性别分布
metrics.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_gender = 1 THEN '男' WHEN is_gender = 2 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END AS gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM person_info WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY gender ORDER BY count DESC

metrics.title: 年龄分布
metrics.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN age IS NULL OR age < 0 THEN '未知' WHEN age < 60 THEN '<60' WHEN age BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN '60-69' WHEN age BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN '70-79' WHEN age BETWEEN 80 AND 89 THEN '80-89' ELSE '90+' END AS age_bucket, COUNT(*) AS count FROM person_info WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY age_bucket ORDER BY age_bucket

metrics.title: 地区分布
metrics.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(provinces_and_cities), ''), '未知') AS region, COUNT(*) AS count FROM person_info WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY region ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 30

metrics.title: 新增趋势
metrics.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM person_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 60

metrics.title: 足压检测次数
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM remote_activity_foot_log WHERE deleted = 0

metrics.title: 足压检测人数
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_name) AS count FROM remote_activity_foot_log WHERE deleted = 0

metrics.title: 健康记录总数
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM person_health_records WHERE deleted = 0

metrics.title: 骨密度检测次数
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM remote_health_bone_log WHERE deleted = 0

metrics.title: 情绪识别记录数
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM remote_psychology_mood WHERE deleted = 0

metrics.title: 有健康档案的老人数
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT phr.person_id) AS count FROM person_health_records phr INNER JOIN person_info p ON p.id = phr.person_id WHERE phr.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted = 0

metrics.title: 足压检测月度趋势
metrics.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM remote_activity_foot_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 36
